description: This file defines data models and request payload classes for various asset-related entities in the backend of a data asset management system. The models correspond to database tables such as asset status logs, additional asset IDs, asset properties, control device mappings, input parameters, parent input mappings, reporting attribute mappings, EF source mappings, throughput equations/scalars, and data input values. The classes include both DTOs for persisted data and request classes for API operations, with validation attributes and detailed documentation.

classes.name: AssetStatusLogDto
classes.description: Represents a record of an asset's operating status, mapping to the asset_status_log table.

classes.name: CreateAssetStatusLogRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a new asset status log entry.

classes.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating an existing asset status log entry.

classes.name: AdditionalAssetIdDto
classes.description: Represents an additional identifier for an asset, corresponding to the additional_asset_id table.

classes.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a new additional asset ID.

classes.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating an existing additional asset ID.

classes.name: AssetPropertyDto
classes.description: Represents a property associated with an asset, mapped to the asset_property table.

classes.name: CreateAssetPropertyRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a new asset property.

classes.name: UpdateAssetPropertyRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating an existing asset property.

classes.name: ControlDeviceMappingDto
classes.description: Represents a control device mapping for an asset, mapped to control_device_mapping.

classes.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a control device mapping.

classes.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating a control device mapping.

classes.name: InputParameterDto
classes.description: Represents an input parameter for assets, mapped to input_parameter.

classes.name: CreateInputParameterRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a new input parameter.

classes.name: UpdateInputParameterRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating an input parameter.

classes.name: ParentInputMappingDto
classes.description: Represents a parent-input relationship between input parameters.

classes.name: CreateParentInputMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating a parent input mapping.

classes.name: UpdateParentInputMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating a parent input mapping.

classes.name: ReportingAttributeMappingDto
classes.description: Represents a reporting attribute mapping for assets.

classes.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload to create a new reporting attribute mapping.

classes.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload to update a reporting attribute mapping.

classes.name: EfSourceMappingDto
classes.description: Represents an EF source mapping for an input parameter.

classes.name: CreateEfSourceMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for creating an EF source mapping.

classes.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingRequest
classes.description: Payload for updating an EF source mapping.

classes.name: ThroughputEquationDto
classes.description: Represents a throughput equation for an input parameter.

classes.name: CreateThroughputEquationRequest
classes.description: Payload to create a throughput equation.

classes.name: UpdateThroughputEquationRequest
classes.description: Payload to update a throughput equation.

classes.name: ThroughputScalarDto
classes.description: Represents a scalar associated with a throughput equation.

classes.name: CreateThroughputScalarRequest
classes.description: Payload to create a throughput scalar.

classes.name: UpdateThroughputScalarRequest
classes.description: Payload to update a throughput scalar.

classes.name: DataInputValueDto
classes.description: Represents a data input value for reporting, mapped to data_input_value.

classes.name: CreateDataInputValueRequest
classes.description: Payload to create a data input value record.

classes.name: UpdateDataInputValueRequest
classes.description: Payload to update a data input value record.
